answer: Treat trust as a living trellis: each agent is a vertex whose standing grows only through endorsements from established peers, so a sybil farm must forge a whole web of fake links rather than one cheap identity. The failure mode is a closed endorsement ring praising itself into legitimacy, so the check is to measure each vertex's paths back to the trusted core and flag clusters whose links never touch basalt-grounded, long-lived identities — a dense island with no bridge to the mainland earns nothing.
